integrity: Exact structural proof and a standalone finite independent-formulation checker accompany the claim. The checker verifies examples but is not a proof for unbounded graph order. No external audit or novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Classification of geometric fixed spaces for transitive actions on the complete-graph fiber; the all-graph formula is combinatorial and intermediate noncolorable homotopy is not classified. No result for nontransitive subgroups or ambient equivariant homotopy types.
title: Symmetric fixed-point filtrations of robust clique complexes of clique prisms
